title: V3 High Chase 追高标签 Shadow Audit
primary_question: 追高标签是否能解释 V3 个股腿盈利 TOP30、亏损 TOP30 和全部已闭合买入样本的差异？
primary_variable: read-only high_chase labels over closed stock trades
fixed_assumptions: D0 closed stock trade reconstruction fixed
D5 3D shadow output fixed for confirmation-failure cross split
no runtime, NAV, signal, ranking, execution, exit, pool, stock, or ETF changes
global quantile labels are post-hoc diagnostics and not deployable live thresholds

evidence.note: human high chase shadow audit report

key_findings: High chase alone is not a clean loss cause: loss TOP30 high_chase share=0.6000, profit TOP30 high_chase share=0.5667.
High chase plus D5 3D confirmation failure is more discriminative: loss TOP30 count=9, profit TOP30 count=2.
Do not use high_chase as a hard no-buy filter; study position sizing/watch/delayed confirmation instead.

audit.high_chase_definition: at least two of short_heat, extension_heat, breakout_stretch
audit.extreme_chase_definition: all three high-chase families, or high_chase with weak breakout quality

decision.reason: 追高不是单独主因，但追高叠加入场后确认失败值得进入下一轮 AB 设计。

next_actions: Design a High Chase + D5 failure watch/size-down AB, not a hard no-buy rule.
Keep high_chase labels read-only until rolling/live-safe thresholds are specified.
